# HD Events

> Corporate audio visual hire and technical event production across London and the UK. HD Events supplies, installs and operates sound systems, wireless microphones, presentation and relay screens, lighting and custom-built digital lecterns for conferences, AGMs, awards ceremonies, gala dinners, live entertainment and festivals.

## Key facts
- Coverage: London-focused, delivering events nationwide across the UK.
- Equipment brands: Sennheiser, sE Electronics, Allen & Heath, Yamaha, KV2 Audio, NEXO.
- Corporate packages from £500 (Speaker Essentials: lectern with microphone, two Sennheiser wireless mics, compact PA, laptop audio connection, delivery, setup and collection; up to 150 guests).
- Custom digital lecterns built to specification from £1,466, or hire from £250 per day plus delivery.
- Recent work includes a corporate dinner beneath Concorde, custom digital lecterns for the Brangwyn Hall in Swansea, concerts in cathedrals and theatres, and stadium and festival events.
- Contact: +44 7930 547024 · hello@hd-events.co.uk · WhatsApp https://wa.me/447930547024

## Services
- [Corporate AV Hire London & UK](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/corporate-av-hire): Corporate AV hire for conferences, AGMs and launches in London and across the UK. Sound, mics, screens, lighting and lecterns with technicians. From £500.
- [Awards Ceremony & Gala Dinner AV Production](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/awards-gala-dinners): Sound, screens, lighting and lecterns for awards ceremonies and gala dinners across London and the UK. Walk-up music, winner graphics and technicians.
- [Live Music, Theatre & Entertainment Sound and Lighting](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/live-entertainment): Sound, lighting and visual production for concerts, live music, theatre and entertainment across London and the UK, with experienced engineers.
- [Festival & Outdoor Event Sound, Stage and Lighting Production](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/festivals-outdoor-events): Festival and outdoor event production across the UK: KV2 Audio and NEXO stage sound, lighting, screens and crew, plus licensing and safety support.
- [Dry Hire: PA, Sound & Lighting Equipment Hire](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/dry-hire): PA, microphone, console and lighting dry hire for crews and production companies. KV2 Audio, NEXO, Allen & Heath, Yamaha and Sennheiser. UK-wide.
- [Digital Lecterns for Sale & Hire UK](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/digital-lecterns): Custom digital lecterns built in the UK with screens, comfort monitors, mic inputs and Kramer CAT6. Built to spec from £1,466, or available to hire.
- [AV Installations for Venues](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/av-installations): Permanent AV installations for venues, halls, churches and offices: sound systems, screens, projectors, lighting and digital lecterns, with training.
- [Event Planning, Licensing & Risk Assessments](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/event-planning): Event planning, licensing, risk assessments and compliance support for festivals, outdoor events and corporate events across the UK.
- [PA Repairs](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/pa-repairs): Repairs for most PA equipment: speakers, amplifiers, mixers and microphones. Send the make, model and fault and we will advise on next steps.
- [AV Delivery & Collection](https://www.hd-events.co.uk/av-delivery-collection): Event AV delivery and collection by experienced technicians, not just drivers. Set up, pack down, stay on as crew and collect the same night. London & UK.
